mapper.select: select count(distinct tp.test_project_id) from test_project tp where tp.del_status = 0
select count(distinct tf.test_flow_id) from test_flow tf inner join test_project tp on tf.test_project_id = tp.test_project_id where tf.del_status = 0 and tp.del_status = 0
select count(distinct tpa.test_project_api_id) from test_project_api tpa inner join test_project tp on tpa.test_project_id = tp.test_project_id where tpa.del_status = 0 and tp.del_status = 0

select count(distinct tfr.test_flow_run_id) from test_flow_run tfr inner join test_flow tf on tfr.test_flow_id = tf.test_flow_id inner join test_project tp on tf.test_project_id = tp.test_project_id where tfr.del_status = 0 and tf.del_status = 0 and tp.del_status = 0

select tp.test_project_id as testProjectId, tp.project_name as projectName, tp.last_api_sync_time as lastApiSyncTime, tp.api_count as apiCount, tp.owner_id as ownerId, su.nick_name as ownerName, tp.update_time as updateTime from test_project tp left join sys_user su on tp.owner_id = su.user_id where tp.del_status = 0
order by tp.update_time desc, tp.test_project_id desc limit 5

select tfr.test_flow_run_id as testFlowRunId, tfr.test_flow_id as testFlowId, tf.test_project_id as testProjectId, tf.flow_name as flowName, tp.project_name as projectName, tfr.status as status, tfr.started_at as startedAt, tfr.finished_at as finishedAt, tfr.duration_ms as durationMs, tfr.trigger_type as triggerType from test_flow_run tfr inner join test_flow tf on tfr.test_flow_id = tf.test_flow_id inner join test_project tp on tf.test_project_id = tp.test_project_id where tfr.del_status = 0 and tf.del_status = 0 and tp.del_status = 0
order by tfr.started_at desc, tfr.test_flow_run_id desc limit 10

select date_format(tfr.started_at, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, sum(case when tfr.status = 'passed' then 1 else 0 end) as passed, sum(case when tfr.status = 'failed' then 1 else 0 end) as failed, sum(case when tfr.status = 'cancelled' then 1 else 0 end) as cancelled, count(1) as total from test_flow_run tfr inner join test_flow tf on tfr.test_flow_id = tf.test_flow_id inner join test_project tp on tf.test_project_id = tp.test_project_id where tfr.del_status = 0 and tf.del_status = 0 and tp.del_status = 0 and tfr.started_at is not null and tfr.started_at >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 6 day)
group by date_format(tfr.started_at, '%Y-%m-%d') order by date asc

select sum(case when tfr.status = 'passed' then 1 else 0 end) as passedCount, sum(case when tfr.status in ('passed', 'failed', 'cancelled') then 1 else 0 end) as finishedCount from test_flow_run tfr inner join test_flow tf on tfr.test_flow_id = tf.test_flow_id inner join test_project tp on tf.test_project_id = tp.test_project_id where tfr.del_status = 0 and tf.del_status = 0 and tp.del_status = 0 and tfr.started_at is not null and tfr.started_at >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 6 day)

select count(distinct tf.test_flow_id) from test_flow tf inner join test_project tp on tf.test_project_id = tp.test_project_id where tf.del_status = 0 and tp.del_status = 0 and tf.api_health_warning_count > 0

select tf.test_project_id as testProjectId, tp.project_name as projectName, tf.test_flow_id as testFlowId, tf.flow_name as flowName, tf.api_health_warning_count as warningCount, tf.api_health_warning_codes as warningCodes, tf.api_health_checked_at as checkedAt from test_flow tf inner join test_project tp on tf.test_project_id = tp.test_project_id where tf.del_status = 0 and tp.del_status = 0 and tf.api_health_warning_count > 0
order by tf.api_health_warning_count desc, tf.api_health_checked_at desc, tf.test_flow_id desc limit 20
